title: Whole-system completed reference for diagonal coefficients
statement: For the completed categories and traces of [det-prop-diagonal-tower-trace] and a specified completed arrow $\delta$ of [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit], define a reference for a family of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams] as follows. At $Y,P,W$ give exact additive equivalences from the completed module presentation to modules over the actual condensed $\mathbf Z_\ell$ coefficient, with natural identifications of their underlying abelian sheaves. The unit isomorphisms commute with every finite $\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1}$ projection, using exactly the reductions of [lem-pur-condensed-zl-reduction-mod-ell-power] and the canonical constant/forgetful comparison of [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-pullback]. The line isomorphisms are fixed by every integral root projection. The supported-source isomorphism is fixed by the underlying diagonal direct image of the unit comparison. The image of the whole arrow $\delta$, through the canonical single/shift comparisons, equals the family's $\mathbf Z_\ell$ arrow. Give the three completed trace presentations, with their projective models equal to the identity, the first product model, and the factor-swapped second product model. Their ordinary realization/direct-image squares commute on underlying sheaves and their derived squares commute with the full universal right-derived units, allowing the two equivalent presentations to have different derived-localization universes. Finally, the image of each completed trace equals the corresponding family trace through these specified squares and endpoint comparisons.
